entries.title: Nahum 3:1
segments: ¶Woe to the bloody city! It [is] all full of lies [and] robbery. [Its] victim never departs.

entries.title: Nahum 3:2
segments: The noise of a whip And the noise of rattling wheels, Of galloping horses, Of clattering chariots!

entries.title: Nahum 3:3
segments: Horsemen charge with bright sword and glittering spear. [There is] a multitude of slain, A great number of bodies, Countless corpses-They stumble over the corpses-

entries.title: Nahum 3:4
segments: Because of the multitude of harlotries of the seductive harlot, The mistress of sorceries, Who sells nations through her harlotries, And families through her sorceries.

entries.title: Nahum 3:5
segments: "Behold, I [am] against you," says the LORD of hosts; "I will lift your skirts over your face, I will show the nations your nakedness, And the kingdoms your shame.

entries.title: Nahum 3:6
segments: I will cast abominable filth upon you, Make you vile, And make you a spectacle.

entries.title: Nahum 3:7
segments: It shall come to pass [that] all who look upon you Will flee from you, and say, 'Nineveh is laid waste! Who will bemoan her?' Where shall I seek comforters for you?"

entries.title: Nahum 3:8
segments: ¶Are you better than No Amon [That was] situated by the River, That had the waters around her, Whose rampart [was] the sea, Whose wall [was] the sea?

entries.title: Nahum 3:9
segments: Ethiopia and Egypt [were] her strength, And [it was] boundless; Put and Lubim were your helpers.

entries.title: Nahum 3:10
segments: Yet she [was] carried away, She went into captivity; Her young children also were dashed to pieces At the head of every street; They cast lots for her honorable men, And all her great men were bound in chains.

entries.title: Nahum 3:11
segments: You also will be drunk; You will be hidden; You also will seek refuge from the enemy.

entries.title: Nahum 3:12
segments: All your strongholds [are] fig trees with ripened figs: If they are shaken, They fall into the mouth of the eater.

entries.title: Nahum 3:13
segments: Surely, your people in your midst [are] women! The gates of your land are wide open for your enemies; Fire shall devour the bars of your [gates].

entries.title: Nahum 3:14
segments: Draw your water for the siege! Fortify your strongholds! Go into the clay and tread the mortar! Make strong the brick kiln!

entries.title: Nahum 3:15
segments: There the fire will devour you, The sword will cut you off; It will eat you up like a locust. Make yourself many-like the locust! Make yourself many-like the [swarming] locusts!

entries.title: Nahum 3:16
segments: You have multiplied your merchants more than the stars of heaven. The locust plunders and flies away.

entries.title: Nahum 3:17
segments: Your commanders [are] like [swarming] locusts, And your generals like great grasshoppers, Which camp in the hedges on a cold day; When the sun rises they flee away, And the place where they [are] is not known.

entries.title: Nahum 3:18
segments: Your shepherds slumber, O king of Assyria; Your nobles rest [in the dust]. Your people are scattered on the mountains, And no one gathers them.

entries.title: Nahum 3:19
segments: Your injury [has] no healing, Your wound is severe. All who hear news of you Will clap [their] hands over you, For upon whom has not your wickedness passed continually?
